import struct

idx = 0
idx |= (1 << 63)          # high bit
idx |= (1 << 59)          # mode = 1 (hexagon)
idx |= (1 << 52)          # resolution = 1
idx |= (0 << 45)          # base cell = 0
idx |= (7 << 42)          # digit at res 1 = 7 (INVALID_DIGIT)
print(hex(idx))
k = 1
data = struct.pack('<Qi', idx, k)
print('len', len(data))
open('/workspace/poc.bin','wb').write(data)
"
